notes.title: Show Your Love with the Supporter Pack DLC! ❤️
notes.notes:
We've heard it all: "Pixel Café is so good, I feel like I robbed you!" Well, worry not – now's your chance to pay it forward with the Supporter Pack DLC!

Packed with aesthetic upgrades for your bedroom, kitchen, and living space, HD wallpapers, high-res artwork, and a character book featuring 11 quirky cards, this pack is the perfect way to support the game and get rewarded with exclusive perks.

Think of it as tipping your favourite barista… except we’ll give you new in-game furniture and a bunch of extra goodies!

Your love keeps our cafes brewing – thanks for your support! ❤️☕

notes.title: Pixel Cafe Soundtrack Now Available!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to share that the Pixel Cafe Soundtrack is now available! If you’ve ever wanted to take the cozy, nostalgic vibes of Pixel Cafe with you, now’s your chance. This soundtrack is packed with soothing lo-fi beats and tunes that perfectly capture the heartwarming moments from the game.

Whether you’re looking for background music while you work or just want to relax, the Pixel Cafe Soundtrack is here to keep you company. It’s like bringing a piece of Pixel’s world into your everyday life. Grab your copy now and let the music take you back to your favorite Pixel Cafe moments!

Happy listening! 🎶

notes.title: Pixel Cafe is Now Steam Deck Verified!
notes.notes:
[h1]Big news Pixel Cafe players! [/h1]

Our cafe adventure is now Steam Deck Verified, offering you the perfect on-the-go gaming experience. 

Plus, we have two heartwarming additions to Pixels room!

[i]Version 1.0.4 Changelog:

[list]
[*] Community Artwork: You can now find 2 new fan art posters in the Pixel room, lovingly crafted by talented Twitch streamers kukkilatte and imtacocat. A huge thank you to these creative souls!

[*] We've improved the Basic Controls window readability by increasing font size, ensuring clear and comfortable navigation. 
 
[*] Cutscene button icons have been enlarged for better visibility on smaller screens. 

[*] Tutorial windows and Pixel house interactions have been refined for ease and clarity.
[/list][/i]

Happy gaming on your Steam Deck or any platform you choose!

Love,
The Pixel Cafe Dev Team

notes.title: New Difficulty Settings & Enhanced Play!
notes.notes:
[h1]Great news, Pixel Cafe players! [/h1]

We've been listening closely to your feedback and are super excited to bring you an update that's all about making your time in Pixel's world even more enjoyable.


[h2]Pixel Cafe version 1.0.3 Changelog[/h2]
[i]
[b]Game Balance Updates:[/b]

- Introducing 3 difficulty modes (Easy - Novice Barista, Medium - Seasoned Barista, Hard - Master Barista) with additional time in levels and mini-games for a more personalized challenge. Your difficulty choice doesn’t affect any unlocks, so feel free to pick the mode that suits you best.

[b]Motion Blur Settings in Nightmare Levels:[/b]

- You may now disable the motion blur effect present in the nightmare levels, for improved visibility and comfort.

[b]Cursor Visibility Fix:[/b]

- Fixed an issue where the active mouse cursor remained visible despite switching control to the gamepad.

[b]Light Switch Minigame fix:[/b]

- The circuit breaker mini-game no longer affects the client wait time, allowing for a more consistent experience.

[b]Improved Mouse Control:[/b]

- Improvements to the mouse controls - it should now be easier to perform your desired actions during gameplay. We're open to feedback on this, so let us know if you run into any issues.

[b]Root Beer Mug Fix:[/b]

- Addressed the frequently occurring double-click issue on the root beer barrel

[/i]


We hope these updates make your Pixel Cafe adventures even more delightful. As always, your feedback is our secret ingredient, so keep it coming!

Happy gaming and see you at the cafes,
[b][i]
The Pixel Cafe Dev Team ❤️[/i][/b]

notes.title: Pixel Cafe is coming out on November 30th!
notes.notes:
Drumroll, please 🥁... We’re elated to declare that Pixel Cafe is brewing to perfection and will be ready for you on November 30th! Our excitement is overflowing, and we can't wait for you to sip on the full experience.

But, hey, if you're eager, why wait? Our Pixel Cafe demo is hot and ready. Give it a taste :)

Okay, enough with puns, to wash this taste off check out our final trailer:

[previewyoutube=U_Jww8EN8n4;full][/previewyoutube]

About Pixel Cafe:

Dive into a pixelated world of coffee and chaos! Pixel Cafe blends the aroma of a visual novel with the rush of time-management. You're playing as Pixel, a barista in a city evolving between its socialist roots and a capitalist bloom. 

Features:

☕ Juggle between crafting coffee and life's decisions.
❤️ Forge relationships, relish the heartwarming stories.
🕐 Experience the rush hour frenzy in the Pixel world.

Ready for a caffeine kick? Try the Pixel Cafe demo and Wishlist!

Stay Connected:

Discord: discord.gg/5dvxcDmRyb

Twitter: https://twitter.com/pixel_cafe

Again, mark your calendars: November 30th. 
Cheers to aromatic adventures ahead! ☕🎮

notes.title: Pixel Cafe Next Fest Stream Part 2!
notes.notes: Welcome to our steamy stream, where Pixel's espresso shots are as strong as the emotions she brews! Dive into a world where coffee beans and life's big dreams blend seamlessly. We're spilling the beans (not literally, that'd be wasteful) on Pixel's journey in the city.

notes.title: Pixel Cafe Next Fest Stream!
notes.notes: Steam’s heating up, and so is our coffee machine! Dive into Pixel's captivating world, where every cappuccino has a story, and every order might just come with a side of unexpected drama. We promise no burnt beans, but we can't say the same for Pixel's heart as she navigates through life. Whether you're a coffee lover or just here for the pixel-art buzz, this stream's got something for you. Cream and sugar, anyone?
